question_en: Which of the following observations are inertial?

A.en: A passenger in a train which is slowing down to a stop
A.ta: மெதுவாக நகர்ந்து சென்று நிற்க கூடிய ஒரு தொடர்வண்டியில் உள்ள பயணி

B.en: A driver in a car moving with a constant velocity

C.en: A pilot in an aircraft which is taking off

D.en: A child revolving in a merry-go-round

subject: Science
explanation_en:
An inertial frame of reference is a frame that is not undergoing acceleration (i.e. either at rest or moving at a constant velocity). A driver in a car moving with a constant velocity is in an inertial frame. Passengers in slowing, taking off, or revolving vehicles undergo acceleration (non-inertial frames).

question_en:
Choose the right matches among the following:
  (1) Aryabhatta - Aryabhatiyam
  (2) Varahamihira - Hast yayu veda
  (3) Brahma Gupta - Brihat Samhita
  (4) Vagbhatta - Ashtanga Sangrah
question_ta:
கீழ்கண்டவற்றுள் சரியாகப் பொருந்தியதைத் தேர்வு செய்க.
  (1) ஆரிய பட்டர் - ஆரிய பாட்டியம்
  (2) வராகமிகிரர் - ஹாஸ் யாயு வேதா
  (3) பிரம்மகுப்தர் - பிருகத் சம்ஹிதா
  (4) வாக்பட்டா - அஷ்டாங்க சங்கரா
subject: Science
explanation_en:
- (1) Aryabhatta authored the famous astronomical work *Aryabhatiyam* (Correct).
  - (2) Varahamihira authored *Brihat Samhita* and *Panchasiddhantika* (not Hastyayurveda, which is a treatise on elephants authored by Palakapya) (Incorrect).
  - (3) Brahmagupta authored *Brahmasphutasiddhanta* (not Brihat Samhita) (Incorrect).
  - (4) Vagbhatta authored *Ashtanga Sangraha*, a treatise on medicine (Correct).

question_en:
The work done in moving a positive charge on an equipotential surface is
  (i) Finite
  (ii) Positive
  (iii) Negative
  (iv) Zero
subject: Science
explanation_en:
By definition, all points on an equipotential surface are at the same electrical potential. Therefore, the potential difference ($\Delta V$) between any two points is zero. The work done in moving a charge $q$ is given by $W = q \Delta V$. Since $\Delta V = 0$, the work done is always zero.

question_en: Among the following, which will have highest dissociation constant (Ka) value?
question_ta: கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றுள் மிக அதிக பிரிகை மாறிலி (Ka) மதிப்பைக் கொண்ட அமிலம் எது?
subject: Science
explanation_en:
Dissociation constant ($K_a$) measures the strength of an acid. HClO, HBrO, and HIO are very weak hypohalous acids. Perchloric acid ($HClO_4$), on the other hand, is a strong mineral acid with an extremely high $K_a$ value because the negative charge on its conjugate base ($ClO_4^-$) is stabilized by resonance across four highly electronegative oxygen atoms.

question_en:
Choose the right matches among the following:
  (1) Hydrogen - Alternative energy
  (2) Biogas - From Non-degradable waste
  (3) Solar energy — Water heating
  (4) Geothermal energy — Wind speed and direction
question_ta:
சரியான பொருத்தங்களைத் தேர்ந்தெடு :
  (1) ஹைட்ரஜன் - மாற்று ஆற்றல்
  (2) உயிரி வாயு - மட்காத கழிவுகளிலிருந்து
  (3) சூரிய ஆற்றல் - நீர் சூடாக்குதல்
  (4) புவி வெப்ப ஆற்றல் - காற்றின் வேகம் மற்றும் திசை
subject: Science
explanation_en:
- (1) Hydrogen is a prominent alternative and clean energy resource (Correct).
  - (2) Biogas is produced by anaerobic digestion of **biodegradable** (degradable) waste, not non-degradable waste (Incorrect).
  - (3) Solar thermal energy is commonly harnessed for water heating applications (Correct).
  - (4) Geothermal energy is heat derived from under the Earth's crust, not related to wind speed or direction (Incorrect).
